name: optional-dependency-test-mocking
description: Pattern for testing modules that depend on optional packages (like ccxt) by injecting mock modules into sys.modules before import. Use when: writing tests for code that uses try/except ImportError, testing modules with optional C extensions or heavyweight dependencies, need to test without installing the real package.
author: Claude Code
context: Testing code that uses optional packages without installing them. Proven with 137 tests for CCXT broker module.
outcome: SUCCESS - Module-level sys.modules injection with real exception hierarchies and autouse fixtures
